name: German Studies (Min)

rules.name: Preparing for the Minor
rules.desc:
Students interested in German Studies should begin by taking a GERLANG 1 or GERLANG 2 language course or lower level 10 or 100-level GERMAN course as a gateway to the major.
They should consider exploring introductory literature, language, or humanities courses early to build background in literary traditions, theory, and languages.
Students should consult the department’s Program Worksheet to map out their intended course of study, electives, and potential thematic or regional focus.

rules.name: Electives

children.name: At least six courses of 3 units or more
GERMAN courses at the 100 or 200 level
ESF and SLE courses (up to 5 units with COLLEGE courses and IntroSems)
Approved courses: Bing Overseas Berlin, relevant IntroSems or COLLEGE courses, courses in other departments

rules.desc:
• Coursework within the department. Additional GERMAN courses at the 100- or 200- level.

• Language coursework. All GERLANG courses from the Language Center may be counted.

• Bing Overseas Program. Courses taken at the Bing Overseas Studies in Berlin program with prior approval of the Director of Undergraduate Studies.

• Education as Self-Fashioning (ESF), Structured Liberal Education (SLE), relevant IntroSems or COLLEGE courses may contribute a maximum of five units.

• Coursework in other departments relevant to the degree, with approval by the Director of Undergraduate Studies.

grading: All courses must be taken for a letter grade, except where letter grades are not offered.
policies: These 24 units may not be used toward any other major or minor.
transferPolicy: A maximum of 5 units of AP or transfer credit may be applied with the approval of the Director of Undergraduate Studies.
reviewNotes: The minor is at least six courses of 3 units or more, 24 units in all, letter graded where a letter grade is offered. GERMAN courses at the 100 or 200 level, GERLANG language courses, and ESF or SLE courses count (ESF, SLE, IntroSems and COLLEGE courses together count for at most 5 units). These units cannot also count toward another major or minor. You add by hand courses the Director of Undergraduate Studies approves: Bing Overseas Berlin, IntroSems, COLLEGE courses, courses in other departments, and up to 5 units of AP or transfer credit.
